CustomField.description: The record ID of the Nonprofit Cloud Gift Designation this fund stands for, typed by an administrator. The Gift Transaction mirror (BarnCRM Mirror) designates each new Gift Transaction's share of this fund to it. Text, not a lookup, so Mirror installs where Nonprofit Cloud does not exist (ADR-0013).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Paste the record ID of the Nonprofit Cloud Gift Designation this fund stands for. Gifts to this fund are then designated to it when the Gift Transaction mirror copies them. Empty means no designation.
CustomField.label: Gift Designation ID
